meta.title: Implement terrain patches to reduce GPU load for large terrains
meta.body_summary: Implement a terrain patch system that subdivides large terrains into smaller geometry chunks to reduce GPU load, with configurable patch sizes, material support, and backward compatibility.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot terrain patch PR with narrative GPU reduction; no review, closed after ~7d with no comments.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 403 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, heavily concentrated in Renderer3d.fs. As a performance PR, it was closed without merge, consistent with the complete lack of review engagement or maintainer feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review, inline comments, or PR discussion recorded in the dataset; the maintainer closed the PR without explanation after approximately 7 days.
review_details.performance_claim: Terrain patch system reduces GPU load by splitting large terrain geometry into smaller chunks, enabling better performance and future optimizations like frustum culling.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by maintainer (bryanedds) without comment; no review interaction detected in dataset.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A large rendering pipeline refactor with no maintainer review; the PR may have exceeded the project's threshold for acceptance without human evaluation, or it was deemed out of scope despite the linked issue.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides conceptual benefits and example usage but no benchmark numbers or reproduction steps; no maintainer verification possible from available data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without feedback; no fix-in-PR cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added TerrainPatch type and patch-based geometry generation in Nu's renderer; introduced PatchSize property to TerrainDescriptor and TerrainFacet; modified terrain rendering pipeline to iterate over patches instead of a single geometry object.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Core/Constants added a default patch size; WorldFacets added PatchSize property; nearly all 403 line changes are in Renderer3d.fs.
change_trajectory: Core terrain patch infrastructure with 197 additions in Renderer3d.fs.
Added PatchSize to TerrainFacet in WorldFacets.fs.
Improved geometry generation with material handling adjustments (176 line changes in Renderer3d.fs).
